default_behavior: Omitting --release retains the nine-person default. V1 saved plan/catalog/audit files are preserved unchanged.

entry_fields.anatomy_present: Observed saved mask presence across same-person native grids, including unreviewed estimates and display references.
entry_fields.anatomy_present_on_primary: Masks on the primary image grid only.
entry_fields.bundle: Repository-relative source bundle path; resolve only after role/release validation.
entry_fields.bundle_sha256: Exact frozen bytes; verify before opening.
entry_fields.input_binding: Exact candidate, metadata/source hashes and validator hashes that bind the receipt.
entry_fields.missing_anatomy: No corresponding nonempty saved mask; does not establish biological absence.
entry_fields.patient_group: Canonical source-person namespace; IXI:265 appears exactly once.
entry_fields.registrations: Source and reference frame hashes, saved status and overlay gate. IXI has three false overlay gates.
entry_fields.role: Frozen TRAIN or DEVELOPMENT; TRAIN does not establish training admission.
entry_fields.status: qualified_with_limitations, rejected, or pending; only successful entries represent engineering qualification.
entry_fields.tumor_location: lobe, hemisphere and anatomical_region remain UNKNOWN unless separately accepted evidence exists.

limitations: IXI source reference and model estimate have partial MRA coverage. Unlabelled voxels are not vessel-free evidence.
IXI registration remains unaccepted; the source-to-T1 reference is a derived resampling, not a new independent source.
vesselFM may overlap IXI training data; individual subject overlap is unknown, and no held-out accuracy is asserted.
Same-person brain/vessel mask presence is one; accepted fused brain/vessel combinations are zero.
No generated descendant or generated/simulated anatomy can enter this acquired-person release.
No inference, registration optimization, download, GUI audit or training was performed by qualification.
purpose: Searchable engineering qualification of the original nine people plus the already materialized IXI265 host. No new acquisition or virtual person is added.
rights: IXI acquired images CC-BY-SA-3.0; public model-assisted/manually refined reference CC-BY-4.0; vesselFM checkpoint research/noncommercial terms remain separate.
